texts: WebGPU exposes a graphics device, buffers and compute pipelines to browser applications. A compute pass submits shader work to the GPU. This supports parallel numerical processing without drawing a visible image.

WebGL primarily exposes graphics rendering to a canvas. WebSocket instead provides a persistent bidirectional network connection. Neither a socket nor an HTTP request provides access to GPU compute pipelines.

IndexedDB stores structured records in a browser origin. A transaction can atomically write model chunks and their metadata. Committed data can survive tab closure and browser restart, subject to storage quotas and eviction.

A JavaScript Map lives in process memory. Reloading the page destroys its entries unless the application has separately persisted them. A cache entry is useful only after its identity and integrity have been checked.

To resume a model download, retain the verified chunks by content hash. On restart validate those chunks again, discover authorized suppliers and request the missing ranges. Reusing a verified chunk avoids transferring those bytes again.

If a supplier returns corrupt bytes, reject the contribution and try another authorized supplier within the transfer budget. Supplier disappearance does not invalidate already verified pieces. The final artifact still needs its full integrity check.

Text embeddings represent passages as numeric vectors. Similarity search compares a question vector with passage vectors to find candidates. A reranker then scores the question together with each candidate to refine their ordering.

A referenced answer should cite the passages supporting its statements. A syntactically valid citation identifies a passage, but does not establish that the answer accurately represents it. Retrieval quality and answer correctness require their own evaluation.

Apple trees need sunlight, drainage and appropriate pollination to produce fruit. Some varieties require a compatible second tree that flowers at the same time. Young trees need watering while their roots become established.
Tomato plants thrive in warm weather and need consistent moisture. They are sensitive to frost. Mulching can reduce evaporation, while good airflow helps limit fungal disease on leaves.

Cancelling a remote job withdraws permission to accept future output from that attempt. An abort signal asks the provider to cooperate. The GPU may still finish submitted commands, so the provider must keep its resource slot occupied until cleanup settles.

A job deadline sets the latest allowed acceptance time. A retry receives a new attempt identity, and late results from an earlier attempt must not replace it. An acknowledgement of message delivery does not prove calculation stopped.
